# Fun Factory Play Café: LLM site summary
# https://funfactoryplay.ca

> Fun Factory Play Café is an indoor playground and kids birthday party centre in Pickering, Ontario, with Littles & Lattés Café on site. Unlimited drop-in play, a toddler zone, private party rooms, and party packages from $399. 1420 Bayly St., Unit 15, Pickering, ON L1W 3R4. Rated 4.4 stars from 850+ Google reviews.

## Contact (NAP)
- Name: Fun Factory Play Café
- Address: 1420 Bayly St., Unit 15, Pickering, ON L1W 3R4, Canada
- Phone: (647) 824-8389
- Email: info@funfactoryplay.ca
- Website: https://funfactoryplay.ca
- Café brand: Littles & Lattés Café (same location)
- Parking: free, in the Bayly Street plaza, minutes from Highway 401

## Service area
Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Scarborough, and Durham Region (east GTA).

## Public play hours
- Monday & Wednesday: 9:30 am to 2:00 pm
- Tuesday & Thursday: 12:00 pm to 7:30 pm (50% off drop-in admissions after 3:30 pm)
- Friday to Sunday: 9:30 am to 8:30 pm
- Special hours for holidays and private events: https://funfactoryplay.ca/play
- Upcoming special hours:
  - October 26, 2026: 9:30 am to 6:30 pm
  - November 1, 2026: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm and 4:00 pm to 8:30 pm
  - November 13, 2026: 9:30 am to 4:00 pm
  - November 22, 2026: 9:30 am to 1:30 pm and 4:30 pm to 8:30 pm

## Drop-in admissions (unlimited play time)
- Under 1: $5.00 (free with paying sibling)
- Ages 1 to 3: $10.00
- Ages 4 to 13: $14.00
- Ages 14 to 17: $10.00
- Two adults per family included with admission
- Access 2 Card holders: $2 off drop-in admission
- Buy drop-in admissions online: https://funfactoryplay.ca/tickets (or pay at the front desk)

## Monthly memberships (unlimited play)
- Ages 0 to 3: $40 monthly, or $35 per month on a 3 month membership
- Ages 4 to 13: $50 monthly, or $45 per month on a 3 month membership
- 2 adults per pass included
- 10% off all Littles & Lattés café items
- Details: https://funfactoryplay.ca/play#memberships
- Sign up: https://the-fun-factory.book.app/pass

## Gift cards
- Buy online for yourself or send as a gift: https://app.squareup.com/gift/ML3ENRYASKQQW/order

## Birthday party packages (2.5 hours, private room)
- Fun Party: $399 (10 kids, 10 adults)
- Active Fun Party: $499 (15 kids, 15 adults)
- Supreme Fun Party: $599 (20 kids, 20 adults)
- Extreme Fun Party: $699 (30 kids, 30 adults)
- Ultimate Fun Party: $999 Mon to Thu / $1,499 Fri to Sun (up to 50 kids, private use of the facility)
- Every package includes playtime, pizza, birthday cake, juice and water, coffee/tea for adults, e-vites, a party host, setup, and cleanup
- Families are welcome to bring their own food and drinks for private parties (food must be nut-free)
- Current promo: 10% off new online party bookings with code SAVE10 (booking and party date on or before December 31, 2026)
- Party decor: Pop & Petal Parties offers preferred pricing and free delivery for Fun Factory parties
- Book a party: https://funfactoryplay.ca/birthday-parties

## Policies
- Socks required for children and adults ($3 at reception)
- Signed waiver required for every child before entry
- Parent supervision required at all times
- Nut-free outside food allowed; no outside drinks during drop-in play
- All sales are final; prices subject to HST
